header.inForce: This {kind} is in force because the pull request that added its file merged. It stops being in force the same way.
header.inForceUnclassified: This record is in force because the pull request that added its file merged. It stops being in force the same way.

editor.readOnly: Your role can read this record and not change it. An org Owner or Admin, or a workspace Owner or Member, can propose a change.
editor.pending: A change is already open on {branch}. Merge or close it before you propose another.
editor.tokenCost: Token cost in the compiled bundle: not recorded

propose.title: Propose a change
propose.diffLabel: The statement in force, then the statement you propose
propose.rationaleHint: One or two sentences for the pull request body. Leave it blank and Oxagen writes that the statement was revised in place.
propose.checksLead: The pull request runs the six publication checks against your wording:
propose.doneNoPr: The proposal is raised. Its pull request is not open yet.
propose.notInForce: Nothing changed here. The record in force moves when someone merges that pull request.

status.proposed: The proposal is raised and its pull request has not opened yet.
status.pr_open: The pull request is open. Its checks have not run yet.
status.checks_passed: All six checks passed. The pull request is ready to merge.
status.checks_failed: At least one check failed. Read the pull request for which one.

lineage.title: Lineage

backing.file: The file on the production branch
backing.registry: The registry mirror, because the repository holds no file

lineage.commitUnknown: Not recorded. Oxagen read the record but could not reach its commit history.
lineage.author: {name} ({login})
lineage.effectUnknown: Not recorded. This workspace has no context-use rollup yet.

related.title: Other records of this kind
related.unclassified: This record carries no kind, so Oxagen has nothing to compare it with.
related.only: This is the only {kind} in force in this workspace.

meters.label: Effect over the runs Oxagen indexed
meters.notRecorded: Effect is not recorded. This workspace has no context-use rollup yet, so Oxagen shows no count rather than a zero that would read as every run ignoring the record.

unclassified.title: This record carries no kind
unclassified.body: The file records no kind, so Oxagen cannot say how this record is selected or what it does. Republish it through a pull request that states its kind, force and scope.

rule.title: Rule
rule.lead: A rule steers how an agent words and shapes its work. It is compiled into the bundle an agent reads before it acts.

placement.prefix: Pinned to a stable prefix, so every run reads it
placement.relevance: Selected by relevance, so a run reads it when it is relevant

rule.placementUnknown: Not recorded. The file states no force.
rule.shareNotRecorded: Not recorded. The bundle's token budget is held per compiled version and no read on this page carries it.
rule.never: A rule cannot stop a call. It changes what an agent reads, not what an agent is allowed to do.

constraint.title: Constraint
constraint.effectUnknown: Not recorded. This workspace holds no require or forbid effect for this record.
constraint.dispatch: A call routed through Oxagen that crosses this boundary is denied before dispatch, with this record cited as the reason.
constraint.grant: That holds only where the record carries an enforcement grant. The grant compiles a gate, which Steering lists under Policy with its gate notice. A record with no grant compiles to text, and nothing refuses a call because of it.
constraint.conflict: Every merge re-runs the conflict check across all published records, so a forbid and a require on the same subject can never both be in force.
constraint.never: A constraint cannot reach a call that does not route through Oxagen, and it cannot grant anyone permission to do anything.

procedure.title: Procedure
procedure.lead: The order is the record. A run that did every step in another order did not follow this procedure.
procedure.never: A procedure cannot make an agent run it. It states the order; nothing refuses a run that departs from it.

fact.title: Fact
fact.lead: A fact is a claim about this workspace that an agent may rely on.
fact.falsifies: Any run that finds the claim untrue. Archive it with a pull request when that happens.
fact.read: {runs, plural, =0 {No runs yet} one {# run} other {# runs}}
fact.never: A fact steers nothing by itself. It tells an agent what is true; a rule or a constraint decides what to do about it.

memory.title: Memory
memory.lead: A memory is one episode: something that happened, kept because it explains a decision.
memory.decay: Nothing decays automatically. A memory that stops being true is archived by a pull request.
memory.recalled: {runs, plural, =0 {No runs yet} one {# run} other {# runs}}
memory.never: A memory cannot decide anything. It explains what happened once; it does not say what to do next time.

preference.title: Preference
preference.lead: A preference is a taste: how this workspace likes work done when nothing requires otherwise.
preference.notFollowed: Nothing here blocks a call. Not following a preference is not a failure, so Oxagen reads the third count as not followed rather than violated.
preference.departure: Runs that did not follow it
preference.never: A preference cannot override a rule or a constraint. Where they disagree, the stronger record wins.

failure.orgRoleRequired: Your role cannot propose a change to this record. An org Owner or Admin, or a workspace Owner or Member, can.
failure.noPrincipal: Oxagen could not tell who is signed in. Sign in again and retry.
failure.recordNotFound: This workspace holds no record on that lineage.
failure.recordUnclassified: This record states no kind, force or scope, so Oxagen cannot write a valid file for it. Republish it through a pull request that states all three.
failure.constraintEffectUnknown: This constraint records no require or forbid effect. Change it through a new proposal, which states the effect.
failure.lineagePrOpen: A change is already open on this record. Merge or close that pull request first.
failure.repositoryMissing: This workspace has no repository bound, so Oxagen has nowhere to open a pull request.
failure.governanceUnreadable: Oxagen could not read governance.toml on the production branch.
failure.githubRefused: GitHub refused the write. Check that the Oxagen app still has write access to the repository.
failure.invalid: Oxagen refused the statement. Check that it is not empty and retry.
failure.pendingApproval: Your change is waiting for approval. The request is {accessRequestId}.
failure.unavailable: Oxagen could not open the pull request: {code}. Retry, and report the code if it repeats.
failure.sectionPending: {section} is waiting for approval. The request is {accessRequestId}.

denied.title: You cannot see this record
denied.body: Reading a steering record needs the steering read permission on this workspace. An org Owner can grant it, and the grant is itself recorded in the audit log.
denied.decidedBy: Deny wins over every allow, so a single deny on your roles is enough to refuse this.

pending.title: This record is waiting for approval
pending.body: Your read parked for approval. The request is {request}.

error.title: This record could not be loaded
error.body: The read did not answer. Retry, and report the code below if it repeats.
